message: No detected untrusted source handling: Data is read from local filesystem paths only (glob, imageio.imread, os.path.join); no remote sources are accessed and no checksum or integrity verification is performed.

No detected label flipping detection: The code never validates label values against an expected set, compares label distributions, or uses any label-noise detection tool; it simply reads masks and passes them through preprocessing.

No detected data poisoning defenses: No outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious samples is performed on the training data; the code only applies image blurring, thresholding, and contour-based cropping.

No detected model integrity verification: The code trains and saves models but does not load pretrained serialized models, and no hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision is implemented anywhere in the pipeline slice.
No detected label distribution validation: The code uses SMOTETomek for resampling but does not explicitly validate or check the label distribution or expected label set before training begins.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural-cleanse-style trigger detection, activation-pattern analysis, or any other backdoor defense mechanism present in the code.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy libraries (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) or mechanisms are imported or used anywhere in the training code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness testing libraries (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD) or any robustness stress tests are imported or used anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: While separate train and test directories are used as arguments, there is no evidence of hashed/signed evaluation data, cryptographic isolation, or multiple independent metric verification to protect against metric manipulation.

No detected input sanitization: The check_args function only validates directory paths and classifier name; there is no validation of image shape, pixel value ranges, or malformed input data on the inference path.

No detected output bounds checks: No code in the provided snippet checks model output probabilities for NaN values, out-of-bounds probabilities, or applies any sanity bounds before returning predictions.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is an image-based ML pipeline using SVMs and classical classifiers, not an LLM, so prompt injection defenses are not applicable and none are present.
